title.narrative: Integrated Urban Solid Waste Management Program.
Programa de Gestin Integral de Residuos Slidos Urbanos

description.narrative: El objetivo del programa es disminuir la disposicin de Residuos Slidos Urbanos (RSU) en Basurales a Cielo Abierto (BCA) e incrementar la disposicin de los mismos en Rellenos Sanitarios (RS) diseados, construidos y operados adecuadamente en centros urbanos y tursticos e incrementar su recuperacin y valorizacin. Se financiarn acciones e iniciativas de educacin y concientizacin, separacin de origen, recoleccin, transporte, transferencia, valorizacin, reciclaje y disposicin final de RSU, orientadas a promover la gestin integral de residuos slidos y que beneficiarn a alrededor de 975 mil hogares con servicios mejorados de recoleccin y disposicin final.

The program objective is to decrease the disposal of urban solid waste (USW) in open dumps, and to increase its disposal in properly designed, built, and operated sanitary landfills in urban and tourism centers, and to increase its recovery and reuse. The program will finance actions and initiatives for education and awareness-raising; for separation at the source; and for the collection, transportation, transfer, recovery, recycling, and final disposal of USW, geared toward promoting integrated solid waste management, and benefitting some 975,000 households with improved collection and final disposal services.
